sources: Spalart and Allmaras (1994), La Recherche Aerospatiale 1, 5-21
Allmaras, Johnson and Spalart (2012), ICCFD7-1902 (S-tilde limiter)
role: independent numerical RANS boundary-layer solution with SA-noft2; not measurements and not an acceptance target for correlations
flow: smooth ZPG flat plate, calorically perfect gas, constant edge state
turbulence: SA-noft2, density-weighted with rho inside diffusion; edge nu_tilde/nu_e = 3; marched from the leading edge
wall_temperature: Tw = ratio * Tr with Tr = Te (1 + Pr^(1/3) (gamma-1)/2 Me^2), or Tw = 300 K for M5-TW300
normalization: Re_x = rho_e U_e x/mu_e; cf uses edge dynamic pressure; delta99 at u/Ue = 0.99; displacement integrated through delta99; momentum thickness integrated to the edge; wall_heat_flux_coefficient is q_w/(rho_e U_e cp Te), positive into the wall

numerics.streamwise: BDF2, 300 geometric stations from x_end 1e-8 to x_end, output x inserted
numerics.solver: damped coupled Newton, five unknowns per node (f, u, g, n, Y), three-color finite-difference Jacobian and banded LAPACK; relaxed Picard fallback, including positivity-clipped SA stations

verification: laminar limit (edge nu_tilde = 0) matches the compressible similarity solution within 0.01%; halving the streamwise step or refining the eta grid changes cf and thicknesses by less than 0.1%
